site.name: DevelopersKit
site.description: 230 free browser-based tools for developers, students, and professionals. Your data stays in your browser — no uploads, no sign-up.

tools.title: JSON Formatter
tools.description: Paste minified or messy JSON and get clean, indented output instantly. Validates syntax and highlights errors so you can fix them fast.

tools.title: JSON Validator
tools.description: Check if your JSON is valid before deploying. Shows the exact error location with line numbers so you can fix syntax mistakes quickly.

tools.title: JSON Minifier
tools.description: Strip whitespace and comments from JSON to reduce file size. Perfect for compressing API responses and config files before deployment.

tools.title: JSON to CSV
tools.description: Turn nested or flat JSON arrays into CSV spreadsheets. Automatically maps keys to columns so you can open the data in Excel or Google Sheets.

tools.title: CSV to JSON
tools.description: Convert CSV rows into clean JSON objects. Paste your spreadsheet data or delimited text and get structured JSON for APIs and databases.

tools.title: XML Formatter
tools.description: Pretty-print minified XML with proper indentation and line breaks. Makes messy SOAP or config files readable at a glance.

tools.title: XML Validator
tools.description: Check XML for syntax errors and malformed tags. Validates your document structure and shows exactly where corrections are needed.

tools.title: YAML Formatter
tools.description: Clean up messy YAML with consistent indentation. Works with nested objects, arrays, and multi-line strings for readable config files.

tools.title: YAML to JSON
tools.description: Convert YAML configuration files to JSON format. Useful when you need to feed YAML data into APIs or tools that only accept JSON.

tools.title: JSON to YAML
tools.description: Transform JSON data into clean YAML format. Ideal for converting API responses into human-readable Kubernetes or Docker configs.

tools.title: Base64 Encoder
tools.description: Encode any text or binary data to Base64. Useful for embedding images in HTML/CSS, encoding credentials for HTTP Basic Auth, or transferring binary data as text.

tools.title: Base64 Decoder
tools.description: Decode Base64-encoded strings back to readable text or raw data. Paste an encoded string to reveal the original content instantly.

tools.title: URL Encoder
tools.description: Convert special characters in URLs to percent-encoded format (%20 for spaces, %26 for &). Essential for building query strings and API requests.

tools.title: URL Decoder
tools.description: Decode percent-encoded URL strings back to readable text. Paste a messy URL with %20 and other codes to see the original characters.

tools.title: HTML Entity Encoder
tools.description: Convert special characters (<, >, &, quotes) to HTML entity codes. Safely display user input or code snippets in HTML without breaking your page layout.

tools.title: HTML Entity Decoder
tools.description: Convert HTML entity codes (<, &, ') back to readable characters. Decode escaped text from HTML source or email templates.

tools.title: UUID Generator
tools.description: Generate v4 UUIDs (random unique identifiers) for database primary keys, API tokens, session IDs, or any system that needs globally unique IDs.

tools.title: Random String Generator
tools.description: Create random strings of any length with customizable character sets. Use for API keys, temporary passwords, tokens, or testing data.

tools.title: Hash Generator
tools.description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-384, or SHA-512 hashes from any input text. Useful for checksums, password hashing verification, and data integrity checks.

tools.title: JWT Decoder
tools.description: Decode JWT (JSON Web Token) strings to view the header, payload, and signature. Debug authentication tokens without installing any tools.

tools.title: Unix Timestamp Converter
tools.description: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back. Debug API timestamps, log files, and database records with instant conversion.

tools.title: Cron Expression Generator
tools.description: Build cron expressions with a visual picker. Generate the correct syntax for scheduled tasks in Linux, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD pipelines.

tools.title: Regex Tester
tools.description: Test regular expressions against sample text in real-time. See match positions and groups to debug patterns before using them in your code.

tools.title: Regex Generator
tools.description: Describe what you want to match in plain English and get a working regular expression. No need to memorize regex syntax for common patterns.

tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.description: Generate placeholder text for mockups, wireframes, and design prototypes. Choose paragraphs, sentences, or words in the quantity you need.

tools.title: CSS Minifier
tools.description: Remove comments, whitespace, and line breaks from CSS to reduce file size. Faster page loads by shrinking your stylesheets.

tools.title: CSS Beautifier
tools.description: Format compressed CSS with proper indentation and line breaks. Make minified stylesheets readable for debugging and editing.

tools.title: HTML Minifier
tools.description: Strip comments, whitespace, and redundant tags from HTML to reduce page size. Faster loads without changing visible content.

tools.title: HTML Beautifier
tools.description: Add proper indentation and line breaks to minified or messy HTML. Read and edit generated or compressed markup easily.

tools.title: JavaScript Minifier
tools.description: Remove whitespace, comments, and shorten variable names in JavaScript to produce smaller, faster-loading script files.

tools.title: JavaScript Beautifier
tools.description: Format minified JavaScript with proper indentation and line breaks. Debug and understand compressed scripts without hunting through single-line code.

tools.title: CSS Gradient Generator
tools.description: Create linear, radial, and conic gradients visually. Pick colors, angles, and stops with a live preview, then copy the CSS code.

tools.title: CSS Box Shadow Generator
tools.description: Design box shadows with controls for offset, blur, spread, and color. See the effect in real time and copy the CSS for your elements.

tools.title: CSS Border Radius Generator
tools.description: Set per-corner border radius values visually. Create rounded corners, pill shapes, or asymmetric designs with live preview.

tools.title: CSS Text Shadow Generator
tools.description: Add text shadows with blur, offset, and color controls. See how different shadow styles look on your text before copying the CSS.

tools.title: CSS Button Generator
tools.description: Design styled buttons with padding, colors, borders, and hover effects. Generate the complete CSS for buttons you can paste into your project.

tools.title: CSS Glassmorphism Generator
tools.description: Create frosted-glass effects with background blur, transparency, and border controls. Generate modern glassmorphism CSS for cards and overlays.

tools.title: CSS Neumorphism Generator
tools.description: Build soft 3D shadow effects for buttons and cards. Adjust light and shadow direction to create the neumorphic look.

tools.title: CSS Transform Generator
tools.description: Combine translate, rotate, scale, and skew transforms visually. See the result on a preview element and copy the combined CSS.

tools.title: CSS Animation Generator
tools.description: Create keyframe animations for fading, sliding, scaling, and bouncing. Set duration and easing, then copy the CSS animation code.

tools.title: CSS Flexbox Generator
tools.description: Design flexbox layouts by picking direction, alignment, wrapping, and gaps. Visualize the result and copy the CSS for your container.

tools.title: CSS Grid Generator
tools.description: Build CSS Grid layouts by defining rows, columns, and gaps. Preview the grid structure and copy the complete CSS.

tools.title: CSS Clamp Generator
tools.description: Generate fluid typography and spacing with CSS clamp(). Set min, preferred, and max values for responsive sizing without media queries.

tools.title: CSS Filter Generator
tools.description: Apply blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, and other CSS filters visually. Adjust sliders and copy the filter code.

tools.title: CSS Color Converter
tools.description: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HWB color formats instantly. Pick a color and get all format variants for your CSS.

tools.title: Word Counter
tools.description: Count words, characters, sentences, and estimate reading time instantly. Perfect for checking essay limits, blog post length, and copywriting targets.

tools.title: Character Counter
tools.description: Count characters with and without spaces. Check text length for social media posts, meta descriptions, and form input limits.

tools.title: Sentence Counter
tools.description: Count the number of sentences in your text. Useful for readability analysis and checking writing density.

tools.title: Paragraph Counter
tools.description: Count paragraphs in your document. Quick check for assignment requirements or content structure.

tools.title: Reading Time Calculator
tools.description: Estimate how long it takes to read your text at average speed. Great for blog posts, articles, and documentation.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.description: Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, and sentence case. Fix capitalization mistakes or format text for different contexts.

tools.title: Uppercase Converter
tools.description: Convert all text to uppercase instantly. Useful for headings, emphasis, or formatting requirements.

tools.title: Lowercase Converter
tools.description: Convert all text to lowercase. Fix accidental caps lock or normalize text for comparison and processing.

tools.title: Title Case Converter
tools.description: Capitalize the first letter of each word automatically. Format titles, headings, and proper nouns consistently.

tools.title: Remove Duplicate Lines
tools.description: Delete repeated lines from text while keeping the first occurrence. Clean up log files, lists, or any text with unwanted duplicates.

tools.title: Sort Lines Alphabetically
tools.description: Sort text lines in ascending or descending alphabetical order. Organize lists, data, and log entries quickly.

tools.title: Reverse Text
tools.description: Reverse text character by character or word by word. Useful for debugging, puzzles, or mirror-text effects.

tools.title: Remove Extra Spaces
tools.description: Collapse multiple spaces and tabs into single spaces. Clean up messy text copied from PDFs or formatted documents.

tools.title: Find and Replace Tool
tools.description: Search for specific text and replace it with new text across your entire document. Works like a word processor find-and-replace.

tools.title: Text Diff Checker
tools.description: Compare two text inputs side-by-side and highlight the differences. Spot changes between document versions or code revisions.

tools.title: Text Cleaner
tools.description: Remove line breaks, extra whitespace, and non-printable characters. Clean messy text copied from emails, PDFs, or web pages.

tools.title: Text to Slug Converter
tools.description: Convert any text to a URL-friendly slug. Translates spaces to hyphens, removes special characters, and lowercases everything.

tools.title: Slug Generator
tools.description: Generate URL slugs from page titles or headings. SEO-friendly format with lowercase, hyphens, and no special characters.

tools.title: Markdown Previewer
tools.description: Write Markdown on the left and see the rendered HTML on the right. Live preview for README files, documentation, and blog posts.

tools.title: Markdown Table Generator
tools.description: Create Markdown tables by defining rows and columns visually. Copy the formatted table syntax for GitHub, docs, or wikis.

tools.title: Markdown to HTML Converter
tools.description: Convert Markdown syntax to clean HTML. Paste your Markdown and get copy-ready HTML for emails, websites, or CMS content.

tools.title: HTML to Markdown Converter
tools.description: Convert HTML pages or snippets to clean Markdown. Extract content from websites for documentation or static site generators.

tools.title: Text to ASCII Generator
tools.description: Convert text to ASCII character codes (decimal, octal, hex). Useful for encoding, debugging character issues, or learning ASCII values.

tools.title: ASCII Art Generator
tools.description: Convert text into ASCII art using different font styles. Create decorative text for terminals, code comments, or social media.

tools.title: Text Line Break Remover
tools.description: Remove hard line breaks from text while preserving paragraph structure. Clean up copy-pasted content from PDFs and emails.

tools.title: Percentage Calculator
tools.description: Find X% of any number, or calculate what percentage one number is of another. Instant results with the formula shown.
tools.formula_text: Result = (Value × Percent) / 100

tools.title: Percentage Increase Calculator
tools.description: Calculate percentage increase between two numbers. Enter the original and new values to see the exact percentage change.
tools.formula_text: Increase % = ((New - Old) / Old) × 100

tools.title: Percentage Decrease Calculator
tools.description: Calculate percentage decrease between two numbers. Enter the original and new values to see the exact drop.
tools.formula_text: Decrease % = ((Old - New) / Old) × 100

tools.title: Ratio Calculator
tools.description: Find the ratio between two numbers in simplest form. Enter two values to get the ratio as A:B and as a fraction.

tools.title: Proportion Calculator
tools.description: Solve proportion problems (A/B = C/D). Enter three known values to find the missing one.

tools.title: Average Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the arithmetic mean of any set of numbers. Enter values separated by commas to get the average instantly.

tools.title: Median Calculator
tools.description: Find the middle value of a sorted number set. Useful for finding the median when data has outliers.

tools.title: Mode Calculator
tools.description: Find the most frequently occurring number in a data set. Works with single and multi-modal data.

tools.title: Standard Deviation Calculator
tools.description: Calculate population or sample standard deviation. Shows the formula and step-by-step result.

tools.title: Mean Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the arithmetic mean (average) of numbers. Enter values to get the sum divided by count.

tools.title: Fraction Calculator
tools.description: Add, subtract, multiply, or divide fractions. Shows the result in lowest terms with the working steps.

tools.title: Decimal to Fraction
tools.description: Convert any decimal number to its fraction equivalent. Shows the fraction in simplified form.

tools.title: Fraction to Decimal
tools.description: Convert any fraction to its decimal equivalent. Shows the result rounded to the precision you need.

tools.title: Mixed Number Calculator
tools.description: Convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions, or calculate with mixed numbers directly.

tools.title: GCD Calculator
tools.description: Find the Greatest Common Divisor of two or more numbers. Useful for simplifying fractions and finding common factors.

tools.title: LCM Calculator
tools.description: Find the Least Common Multiple of two numbers. Essential for adding fractions with different denominators.

tools.title: Prime Number Checker
tools.description: Check if a number is prime or composite. Enter any positive integer to get an instant answer.

tools.title: Prime Number Generator

tools.title: Factor Calculator
tools.description: Find all factors (divisors) of a number. Enter any positive integer to see every number that divides it evenly.

tools.title: Scientific Notation Converter
tools.description: Convert between standard notation and scientific notation (e.g. 123000 = 1.23 × 10^5).

tools.title: Binary Calculator
tools.description: Perform arithmetic on binary numbers. Add, subtract, multiply, or divide in base-2.

tools.title: Binary to Decimal
tools.description: Convert binary (base-2) numbers to decimal (base-10). Enter a binary string to get the decimal equivalent.

tools.title: Decimal to Binary
tools.description: Convert decimal numbers to binary (base-2). Enter any number to see its binary representation.

tools.title: Hex to Decimal
tools.description: Convert hexadecimal (base-16) to decimal (base-10). Enter a hex value to get the decimal number.

tools.title: Decimal to Hex
tools.description: Convert decimal numbers to hexadecimal (base-16). Enter any number to see its hex representation.

tools.title: Octal Converter
tools.description: Convert between octal (base-8) and decimal (base-10) number systems. Enter a value in either format.

tools.title: Roman Numeral Converter
tools.description: Convert between Roman numerals and Arabic numbers. Enter 1–3999 to get the Roman numeral, or vice versa.

tools.title: Random Number Generator
tools.description: Generate random integers or decimals within any range. Set minimum, maximum, and quantity for custom random numbers.

tools.title: Exponent Calculator
tools.description: Calculate any base raised to any power. Enter the base and exponent to get the result instantly.

tools.title: Square Root Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the square root of any positive number. Shows the result with decimal precision.

tools.title: Grade Calculator
tools.description: Convert test scores to letter grades (A–F). Enter marks obtained and total to see your percentage and grade.

tools.title: GPA Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your GPA by entering course grades and credit hours. Supports the standard 4.0 scale.

tools.title: CGPA Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your Cumulative GPA across multiple semesters. Add courses from each term to get your overall CGPA.

tools.title: Percentage to GPA Calculator
tools.description: Convert a percentage score to GPA on the 4.0 scale. Enter your percentage to see the equivalent GPA.

tools.title: Exam Percentage Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your exam percentage from marks obtained and total marks. Quick result with the formula shown.

tools.title: Marks Percentage Calculator
tools.description: Find the percentage of marks you scored. Enter marks obtained and maximum marks for an instant calculation.

tools.title: Final Grade Calculator
tools.description: Calculate what grade you need on the final exam to achieve your target course grade. Enter current grade and weight.

tools.title: Weighted Grade Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your grade with different weights for assignments, exams, and participation. Enter each component and its percentage weight.

tools.title: Study Time Calculator
tools.description: Estimate how many hours you need to study based on topic difficulty and exam date. Plan your revision schedule.

tools.title: Pomodoro Timer
tools.description: Work in focused 25-minute intervals with 5-minute breaks. Track completed Pomodoro sessions for productive study time.

tools.title: Exam Countdown
tools.description: Count down the days, hours, and minutes until your exam. Set the date and see exactly how much time you have left.

tools.title: Assignment Countdown
tools.description: Track how many days remain until your assignment is due. Set the deadline and stay on top of your submissions.

tools.title: Semester Countdown
tools.description: See how many days are left in the current semester. Set the end date to track remaining study time.

tools.title: Study Schedule Generator
tools.description: Create a weekly study timetable based on your subjects and available hours. Print or copy the generated schedule.

tools.title: Revision Schedule Generator
tools.description: Plan your revision sessions leading up to exams. Allocates topics across available days for balanced preparation.

tools.title: Flashcard Generator
tools.description: Create study flashcards with a question on one side and answer on the other. Export for Anki or print for offline study.

tools.title: Random Quiz Generator
tools.description: Generate a random quiz from your own question bank. Set the number of questions and get a unique quiz each time.

tools.title: Multiplication Table Generator
tools.description: Generate multiplication tables for any number. See the table formatted for quick reference or printing.

tools.title: Times Table Quiz
tools.description: Practice multiplication tables with timed quizzes. Test your speed and accuracy on times tables from 1 to 20.

tools.title: Random Math Quiz
tools.description: Generate random math problems at different difficulty levels. Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

tools.title: Equation Solver
tools.description: Solve linear equations step by step. Enter your equation and see the solution with the working shown.

tools.title: Quadratic Equation Solver
tools.description: Solve quadratic equations using the quadratic formula. Enter coefficients a, b, and c to get real and complex roots.

tools.title: Factorial Calculator
tools.description: Calculate n! (n factorial) for any non-negative integer. See the step-by-step multiplication.

tools.title: Scientific Calculator
tools.description: Perform advanced math: trigonometry, logarithms, powers, roots, and more. A full scientific calculator in your browser.

tools.title: Unit Conversion Calculator
tools.description: Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, volume, and more. Supports dozens of common unit pairs.

tools.title: Age Calculator
tools.description: Find your exact age in years, months, and days. Enter any birth date to see how old someone is today.

tools.title: Date Difference Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the exact number of days between any two dates. Useful for project timelines, age gaps, and deadlines.

tools.title: Days Between Dates
tools.description: Find how many days are between two dates. Enter start and end dates for an instant count.

tools.title: Weeks Between Dates
tools.description: Calculate the number of weeks between two dates. Enter any two dates to get the week difference.

tools.title: Months Between Dates
tools.description: Find how many months are between two dates. Useful for contract durations, subscription periods, and age calculations.

tools.title: Business Days Calculator
tools.description: Count only working days (Monday–Friday) between two dates. Excludes weekends for accurate project planning.

tools.title: Working Days Calculator
tools.description: Calculate working days between two dates. Similar to business days, useful for shift planning and deadlines.

tools.title: Days Until Date
tools.description: Count down from today to any future date. See exactly how many days remain until your event or deadline.

tools.title: Date Addition Calculator
tools.description: Add days, weeks, months, or years to any date. Find out what date it will be after a given period.

tools.title: Date Subtraction Calculator
tools.description: Subtract days, weeks, months, or years from any date. Find out what date it was before a given period.

tools.title: Time Difference Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the difference between two times. See hours, minutes, and seconds between any two timestamps.

tools.title: Time Duration Calculator
tools.description: Calculate total duration from start and end times. Convert hours and minutes to total minutes or hours.

tools.title: Hours to Minutes Converter
tools.description: Convert hours to minutes instantly. Enter any number of hours to get the equivalent in minutes.

tools.title: Minutes to Seconds Converter
tools.description: Convert minutes to seconds. Enter any number to see the conversion.

tools.title: Seconds to Hours Converter
tools.description: Convert seconds to hours and minutes. Enter a total seconds value to get the human-readable duration.

tools.title: Unix Timestamp Generator
tools.description: Get the current Unix timestamp (seconds since Jan 1, 1970) or convert a date to Unix time.

tools.title: Leap Year Checker
tools.description: Check if a year is a leap year. Enter any year to find out if it has 366 days.

tools.title: Day of Week Calculator
tools.description: Find out what day of the week any date falls on. Enter a date to see Monday, Tuesday, etc.

tools.title: Week Number Calculator
tools.description: Find the ISO week number for any date. Enter a date to see which week of the year it is.

tools.title: Date Format Converter
tools.description: Convert dates between formats: ISO 8601, US (MM/DD/YYYY), UK (DD/MM/YYYY), and more.

tools.title: Simple Interest Calculator
tools.description: Calculate simple interest using I = P × R × T. Enter principal, rate, and time to see the interest earned or owed.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Simple Interest = P × R × T / 100 where P = Principal, R = Annual Interest Rate (%), T = Time in years

tools.title: Compound Interest Calculator
tools.description: Calculate compound interest with monthly, quarterly, or annual compounding. See total amount and interest earned.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt) where P = Principal, r = annual rate, n = compounds per year, t = years

tools.title: Loan EMI Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your Equated Monthly Installment for any loan. Enter principal, interest rate, and tenure to see your EMI.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1) where P = Principal, r = monthly rate, n = months

tools.title: Mortgage Calculator
tools.description: Estimate monthly mortgage payments for home loans. Enter loan amount, rate, and term to see principal and interest split.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: M = P[r(1+r)^n]/[(1+r)^n-1] where P = Principal, r = monthly rate, n = months

tools.title: Loan Payment Calculator
tools.description: Calculate total loan payments including interest. See monthly payment amount and total cost of borrowing.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Monthly Payment = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)

tools.title: Loan Interest Calculator
tools.description: Find the total interest you'll pay on a loan. Compare different interest rates to find the cheapest option.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Total Interest = (Monthly Payment × Months) - Principal

tools.title: Investment Return Calculator
tools.description: Calculate returns on your investment. Enter initial amount, rate, and duration to see projected value.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Return = ((Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value) × 100

tools.title: CAGR Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the Compound Annual Growth Rate of an investment. Enter beginning value, ending value, and years.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: CAGR = (FV/PV)^(1/n) - 1 where FV = Future Value, PV = Present Value, n = years

tools.title: SIP Calculator
tools.description: Estimate returns on Systematic Investment Plans (SIP). Enter monthly amount, rate, and duration for projected value.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: FV = P × [((1+r)^n - 1) / r] where P = Monthly investment, r = monthly rate, n = months

tools.title: Inflation Calculator
tools.description: See how inflation erodes purchasing power over time. Enter current amount and inflation rate to find future value.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Future Value = Present Value × (1 + Inflation Rate)^Years

tools.title: Savings Goal Calculator
tools.description: Find how much you need to save monthly to reach a financial goal. Enter target amount, timeline, and interest rate.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Monthly Savings = Goal / (Months × (1 + Monthly Rate))

tools.title: Retirement Calculator
tools.description: Estimate how much you need to save for retirement. Enter current savings, monthly contribution, and expected returns.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Required Savings = Annual Expenses × 25 (4% rule)

tools.title: Discount Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the discounted price and savings. Enter original price and discount percentage to see the final price.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Sale Price = Original Price × (1 - Discount%/100)

tools.title: Sale Price Calculator
tools.description: Find the sale price after a discount. Enter the original price and discount amount or percentage.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Sale Price = Original Price - (Original Price × Discount / 100)

tools.title: Markup Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the selling price from cost and markup percentage. Enter cost and margin to set your price.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Selling Price = Cost × (1 + Markup%/100)

tools.title: Profit Margin Calculator
tools.description: Calculate net profit margin from revenue and costs. See your margin as a percentage.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Margin = ((Revenue - Cost) / Revenue) × 100

tools.title: Break Even Calculator
tools.description: Find how many units you need to sell to break even. Enter fixed costs, variable cost per unit, and selling price.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Break-even units = Fixed Costs / (Price per unit - Variable cost per unit)

tools.title: Tip Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the tip and total bill. Enter the bill amount and tip percentage (10%, 15%, 20%) to see the split.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Tip = Bill × (Tip% / 100), Total = Bill + Tip

tools.title: Split Bill Calculator
tools.description: Split a bill evenly between any number of people. Enter total and headcount to see per-person amount.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Per Person = Total Bill / Number of People

tools.title: Salary Calculator
tools.description: Convert between annual, monthly, weekly, and hourly salary. See take-home pay after taxes.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Annual = Monthly × 12, Weekly = Annual / 52, Hourly = Weekly / 40

tools.title: Hourly to Yearly Salary
tools.description: Convert your hourly wage to annual salary. Enter hourly rate and hours per week for the yearly equivalent.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
tools.formula_text: Annual = Hourly Rate × Hours per Week × 52

tools.title: Yearly to Hourly Salary
tools.description: Convert annual salary to hourly rate. Enter yearly salary and weekly hours for the per-hour amount.
tools.disclaimer: This calculator is for informational and educational purposes only. It does not constitute financial advice. Consult a qualified financial advisor for decisions about loans, investments, or business strategy.
